svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Components sheet 1, alternative B: In context
svg.desc: Components at real size on the faded screens where they open: the Key colour popover over a live-previewing aisle wall, the Apply all confirm popover on Recommendations, the Delete plan dialog over Saved plans, an Undo toast after Apply, the read-only Settings page, and the buttons used. Synthetic data.
svg.text: Each component at real size, on the screen where it opens. The app behind it is faded;
what the component changes stays at full strength.
